# NEMUN 2026

> NEMUN 2026 is NEHSMUN's annual Model United Nations conference held in Hsinchu, Taiwan, featuring multiple UN committees and comprehensive delegate resources.

NEMUN 2026 is the premier Model UN conference organized by National Experimental High School (NEHS) in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The conference brings together delegates to participate in authentic UN committee simulations, with detailed guidance on registration, logistics, and committee topics.

## Conference Overview

- [NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org): Homepage for NEMUN 2026, NEHSMUN's annual Model UN conference in Hsinchu
- [About Us | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/about): Overview of NEMUN, NEHSMUN, and the Model United Nations conference organization

## Committee Guides

- [UNSC | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/unsc): UNSC committee guide covering Venezuela crisis and humanitarian assistance topics
- [UNDP | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/undp): UNDP committee guide on digital divide, sustainable development, and climate resilience
- [GA3 | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/ga3): GA3 committee guide covering digital divide and sustainable development topics

## Delegate Registration & Logistics

- [Registration | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/registration): Registration page with conference fees, accommodation pricing, and early-bird deadlines
- [Accommodation | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/accommodation): Accommodation information and hotel booking details for delegate lodging in Hsinchu
- [Transportation | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/transportation): Transportation guide covering Taiwan High Speed Rail and venue access directions

## Venue Information

- [Venue | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/venue): Venue details for National Experimental High School at Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan

## Conference Leadership

- [nemun](https://www.nemun.org/secretariats): Secretariat leadership profiles including Secretary-General Diana Hsieh and Deputy SG
- [Meet the team | NEMUN 2026](https://www.nemun.org/studentofficers): Student officer and team leadership profiles for NEMUN 2026 conference organizers
